item.title: AtmosCheck 0.1
item.description:
AtmosCheck 0.1

  • macOS app: drop ADM BWF masters (and stereo masters) on the window, get a pass/fail report per Apple Music / Dolby rule, a channel table with binaural modes, and an album overview with cross-track checks.
  • Conform sheet: gain to the loudness ceiling, start alignment and length match against the stereo master, written as a new ADM file that is added back to the list for verification.
  • Native Swift engine (AtmosCheckKit): RIFF/RF64 reader, ADM and Dolby dbmd parsing, BS.1770-4 loudness and 4x true peak, approximate 5.1/2.0 re-render, cross-correlation sync. Matches the Python prototype's numbers on real masters and runs a 2-minute master in under a second.
  • Command line twin `atmoscheck-cli` for scripts and parity checks.
  • In-app updates through Sparkle (weekly check, AtmosCheck > Check for Updates…) and a release script that builds, tests, signs, makes the disk image and publishes.
  • Provenance check (PROV-01/02): flags Atmos masters that reconstruct the stereo master almost exactly, the signature of upmixes and de-mixed stems that label QC rejects.
